author: ADDITION
notes: No cheats yet: find them with the Scanner while you play. Start with your money or a resource you can see on screen: note it, change it in game, scan again. Try i32 first, then f32. The game runs as SlavesOfRome-Win64-Shipping.exe (the small SlavesOfRome.exe is only its launcher), and pointer paths should start from the Shipping .exe.
